name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
      Gray-Scott with coupled 'history' and 'wave' reagents formula by Dan Wills.
	  
	  Short moving-dividing fronts of 'b' form and propagate across space generating lengthy diffusing trails in the history 'c' reagent. 
	  
	  The 'b' reagent is also emitted into the wave reagent 'd', and the wave-result is fed back negatively into 'c'. 
	  
	  The result in 'c' forms interesting soft large blobs that appear to ripple and have sharper details on them near the 'b'-fronts.
	  
	  What we see in 'c' reminded me of cauliflower a bit, hence name of the pattern.
      
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.04
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.018
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_k">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_F">
        0.003
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_b">
        -0.005
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Da">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Db">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_a_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_b_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="cDamp">
        0.0007
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.005
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_c">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow_norm">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="wave_diffusion">
        0.007
      </param>
      <param name="wave_damp">
        0.9985
      </param>
      <param name="wave_power">
        1.001
      </param>
      <param name="a_wave">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="b_wave">
        0.03
      </param>
      <param name="c_wave">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_F">
        -0.05
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_k">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_b">
        -0.003
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_c">
        -0.004
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="5">
        delta_a = (D_a + c*c_to_Da) * laplacian_a - a*b*b + (F + c_to_F*c + d*wave_to_F)*(1.0f-a) + (c*c_to_a) + d * wave_to_a;
        delta_b = (D_b  + c*c_to_Db) * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ((F + c_to_F*c + d*wave_to_F)+(k + c*c_to_k + d*wave_to_k))*b + (c*c_to_b) + d * wave_to_b;
        delta_c = -c*cDamp + a*a_to_c + b*b_to_c + D_a_to_c * laplacian_a + D_b_to_c * laplacian_b + D_c * laplacian_c  + d * wave_to_c;
        c = clamp( pow( fabs(c)/c_pow_norm, c_pow )*c_pow_norm, 0.0f, 1.0f );
        d = clamp( sign(d) * pow( fabs(d) * wave_damp, wave_power ) + a * a_wave + b * b_wave + c * c_wave, -500.0f, 500.0f );
        delta_e = laplacian_d * wave_diffusion;
        delta_d = e + delta_e;
        
      </formula>
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <constant value="0.7">
        </constant>
        <everywhere>
        </everywhere>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0.01" high="0.199">
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.1" y="0.1" z="0.1">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.9" y="0.9" z="0.9">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <subtract>
        </subtract>
        <other_chemical chemical="b">
        </other_chemical>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
	  <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0.49" high="0.51">
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0" y="0" z="0">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="1.0" y="1.0" z="1.0">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>

    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="false">
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="c">
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="0">
      </low>
      <high value="1">
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="15">
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0.25">
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="11">
      </timesteps_per_render>
      <show_phase_plot value="false">
      </show_phase_plot>
      <phase_plot_x_axis value="a">
      </phase_plot_x_axis>
      <phase_plot_y_axis value="b">
      </phase_plot_y_axis>
      <phase_plot_z_axis value="c">
      </phase_plot_z_axis>
    </render_settings>
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 511 0 511 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
